marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 關於我在無意間被隔壁的天使變成廢柴這件事9 | Guan yu wo zai wu yi jian bei ge bi de tian shi bian cheng fei chai zhe jian shi 9

Zhou, who is celebrating his birthday, truly feels the changes that have taken place thanks to True Day, and even though he is a little embarrassed, he savors the happiness. He decides to send all his blessings on the day of Manabu's birth, and he spends his days preparing for it. In the meantime, the two of them, who are contemplating their future in higher education, begin to visualize their future together and make a pact to overcome the challenges of studying and preparing for the exams together. Then comes the long-awaited birthday of Manami. In order to make this day special, Zhou prepares a surprise ...... This is a sweet and heart-warming love story with a cute neighbor!
